item_title: CEO Dave Baszucki says Roblox sees 2M+ daily active users in Russia, while competitors like EA, Nintendo, and Ubisoft have slowed or ceased sales in the country
item_description: Cecilia D'Anastasio / Bloomberg: CEO Dave Baszucki says Roblox sees 2M+ daily active users in Russia, while competitors like EA, Nintendo, and Ubisoft have slowed or ceased sales in the country — Roblox Corp.'s popularity in Russia is increasing even as almost every other publicly traded gaming company has retreated from the country after its invasion of Ukraine.

item_title: In a letter to Twitter, Musk's legal team cited Twitter's ~$7M settlement with Peiter Zatko as a violation of the merger agreement and a reason to end the deal
item_description: The Verge: In a letter to Twitter, Musk's legal team cited Twitter's ~$7M settlement with Peiter Zatko as a violation of the merger agreement and a reason to end the deal — He sent a letter to Twitter on Friday — Elon Musk has sent a third letter to Twitter attempting to terminate his $44 billion acquisition of the company.
